record.original_question: By definition, a constructible totally disconnected, locally compact(tdlc) group is the result of a sequence of profinite extensions and ascending HNN-extensions starting from the trivial group. As in the discrete case, soluble constructible tdlc groups have type F P∞ (G. C. Cook, I. Castellano, J. Algebra, 543(2020), 54–97). Are soluble tdlc groups of type F P∞ constructible?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological group is called totally disconnected and locally compact (tdlc) if it is Hausdorff, locally compact, and its connected component of the identity is trivial. Within the class of tdlc groups, define the class of constructible tdlc groups recursively as the smallest class such that:
(i) the trivial group is constructible;
(ii) if N is a compact (equivalently, profinite) tdlc group, H is constructible, and 1 → N → G → H → 1 is a short exact sequence of tdlc groups (a profinite extension), then G is constructible;
(iii) if H is constructible and G is an ascending HNN-extension of H along a continuous, injective, open endomorphism of H (in the topological/tdlc sense), then G is constructible.

A tdlc group G is said to be of type FP_∞ (in the sense of rational discrete cohomology for tdlc groups) if the trivial rational discrete G-module Q admits a resolution by finitely generated projective rational discrete G-modules of every finite length, equivalently, by finitely generated projective rational discrete G-modules in every degree.

A tdlc group G is called soluble if it admits a finite series of closed normal subgroups
{1} = G_0 ◁ G_1 ◁ … ◁ G_n = G
such that each quotient G_{i+1}/G_i is abelian.

It is known that every soluble constructible tdlc group is of type FP_∞.

Question: Conversely, is every soluble tdlc group of type FP_∞ constructible?

A web search reveals active recent research on finiteness properties of tdlc groups by Castellano, Corob Cook, and collaborators (including 2024 work on the Schlichting completion), but no source establishing or refuting the converse implication for soluble tdlc groups of type FP_∞ was found. The problem appears to be open.
